feedback: Semantic fidelity holds. u0 (pre-pickup) -> u1 on the first holding_box (+0.1, one-shot since u0 is never re-entered, so drop/re-pickup loops cannot farm it). A fall from u1 goes to u2 (-0.1); from u2 the very next label must show holding_box (recovery -> u1, +0.1) or the machine drops to absorbing failure u3 (-0.5), which correctly voids the task after one missed recovery and permanently blocks u4. u4 is entered only via at_exit & holding_box with a clean recovery history, exactly matching 'reach the exit carrying the box with every fall recovered on the very next move'; the u2 next-step check is exact because after a fall the hands are empty, so holding_box at t+1 is equivalent to a pickup on that move. Exiting without the box (from u0 or u1) falls into else self-loops with 0 and never pays the final reward; exiting without a pickup immediately after a fall lands in u3 (-0.5), matching the double violation. Reachability: u4 is reachable (u0->u1->u4) and every declared state is reachable. Compactness: five states, each necessary (u0 vs u1 keep the pickup bonus unexploitable; u2 tracks the just-fell step; u3 is the absorbing failure; u4 accepting). Predicate-only events: only supplied propositions are used; siren_ringing and switch_toggled are irrelevant and absorbed by per-state else self-loops present in all five states. Persistent/event distinctions are respected: box_fell is used only as an event trigger, at_exit only in the last-step accepting conjuncts, holding_box as a condition. Ordered coverage: within each state the guards are mutually exclusive given the environment constraints (box_fell never co-occurs with holding_box or at_exit; at_exit only on the final step), and each state's else guarantees total coverage. Reward safety: rewards are bounded and unfarmable — the u1<->u2 recovery cycle nets 0 and can occur at most twice (at most two falls per episode); max total ≈ 0.1 + 1.0 = 1.1, worst case ≈ -0.6; the final 1.0 dominates; failure regression is explicit (-0.5 into absorbing u3). Progress shaping is as dense as the proposition set allows (pickup, recovery, failure, exit). Three branches are unreachable dead code given the constraints — (u0, box_fell) (a fall requires a prior holding_box, which always moves u0->u1 first), (u2, box_fell) (consecutive falls impossible), and (u2, at_exit & holding_box) (a pickup and an exit step cannot coincide) — but they are harmless defensive defaults with sensible successors. Format check passes: nonempty FINAL_STATES header with u4 declared in STATES and accepting for the task; headers, (s,e)->s' transitions, (s,e,s')->r rewards, else loops, and & / ! guards match the paper convention, with omitted rewards defaulting to 0.

The function set is exactly the environment-declared proposition set: no extras, none missing, and the declared-but-unused-by-this-reward-machine siren_ringing and switch_toggled are correctly defined rather than omitted. Code is plain Python with no imports, no actions, no side effects, and does not read or mutate episode memory; no runtime errors are possible given the guards.
